meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: Claude会持续盯一个拉取请求（PR）直到它可合并：轮询CI检查、读取新评论与未解决的审查线程，把真实问题修成提交并推送，反复直到检查通过、无遗留问题才停下并报告证据。
howto.when: 当用户要求“babysit”、“monitor”或“keep checking”某个PR，即持续关注其评论、审查和CI直至所有可处理问题解决时触发。

say.note: Claude会开始轮询检查并处理评论。

say.text: 监视#123的审查线程，有未解决的就修复。
say.note: 它会用GraphQL拉取未解决线程并处理。

say.text: 持续检查PR评论和CI，可解决的全部解决。
say.note: 它会反复循环直到无遗留问题。

howto.what_en: Claude will keep watching a pull request until it is mergeable: it polls CI checks, reads new comments and unresolved review threads, fixes real issues in commits, pushes, and repeats until checks pass and no actionable items remain, then reports evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to babysit, monitor, or keep checking a PR—that is, keep watching its comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit this PR until CI is all green.
say_en.note: Claude starts polling checks and handling comments.

say_en.text: Watch review threads on #123 and fix unresolved ones.
say_en.note: It fetches unresolved threads via GraphQL and acts.

say_en.text: Keep checking comments and CI, resolve everything actionable.
say_en.note: It loops until no actionable items remain.
